info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Careers Applications Jobs-v5-spec
info.description: The Career Applications Job Listings API provides a comprehensive view of job opportunities available within the organization. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed listings of career applications with information about each job position, including job title, requirements, and application status. It is intended for use by job seekers, HR personnel, and application tracking systems to streamline the recruitment process. Developers can integrate this API to enhance their platforms with up-to-date job information, facilitating better decision-making for potential candidates.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of jobs from applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all jobs associated with applications in the system. It provides relevant job details which can help users manage or analyze job listings effectively.
